Follows the octet rule.

Follows the octet rule.

The ozone molecule can be drawn with resonance structures where the central oxygen atom has one single bond, one double bond, and one lone pair (8 electrons). The terminal oxygen atoms also have complete octets.

Follows the octet rule.

Does not follow the octet rule.

Does not follow the octet rule.
